001Who we areWe build AI-driven, local-friendly mobile applications for Android and iOS — software that runs on your device, not in a data centre.

002ValueWhy Dream Team?We build mobile-specific, AI-powered applications that keep working when the network does not.01AI-Driven by DefaultEvery app ships with a model on the device, not an API key in the cloud.02Local-Friendly Architecture
01AI-Driven by DefaultEvery app ships with a model on the device, not an API key in the cloud.
02Local-Friendly ArchitectureOffline-first by design. No accounts, no sync, no telemetry — your data stays where it belongs.
03Built for Real PhonesSmall binaries, fast cold starts, honest battery use — tuned for mid-range Android and iOS.

003CapabilitiesOur AI-Driven StackWhat we actually build with — from the camera pipeline to the model runtime on the phone.On-Device InferenceVision, text and speech models running locally — no round-trip, no queue, no metered data.Quantise

Conversational AppsChat, voice and avatar interfaces that keep their context between sessions.
Mobile-First InterfacesNative-feel UI built for one hand, one thumb and a six-inch screen.
On-Device RetrievalAnswers grounded in your photo roll and the live web — with sources, storing nothing.
Memory & ContextRunning context, retrieval and personalisation that never leave the phone.

009StudioWhat We BelieveFour rules that decide what we build, what we drop, and what we refuse to ship.01On-device firstIf a phone can run it, a phone should run it. Latency, privacy and cost all point the same direction.02Local-friendlySof
01On-device firstIf a phone can run it, a phone should run it. Latency, privacy and cost all point the same direction.
02Local-friendlySoftware that respects where you are: cheap data, weak signal, mid-range hardware, older Android.
03AI-drivenThe model is the product, not a chatbot bolted onto a form. Every screen exists because of what the model can do.
04Craft over templatesNo store template, no stock flow. Each app is designed around one job and shipped when it does it well.
